quotes.quote: As an unexpected benefit, each day I received photos, showing the completed work to date.
Showed up on time, inspected the roof as requested and provided photos and a written report the next day.
Before and after photos are really useful.
Knowing that we were not able to check on the progress from Florida, Ralph kept us up to date with emails and photos - both before and after.
He took pictures and explained in detail what could be done to repair it.
Clean up was superb each day.
The crew did a pretty good job of cleaning up much of the debris at the end of each workday.
The crew we had did a great job in cleaning up after the job was done.
The roofing crew were timely, efficient, and kept the worksite neat and tidy.
Every detail was taken care of by the Apex team and the clean up was better than when they started.
Very responsive and professional.
Ralph explained to me all that would be done during the replacement.
Ralph and his son Pierce communicated with us very well and was easy to work with on this job.
They kept me updated on the progress and I could not have been more pleased with the results.
Not only did Apex provide a beautiful roof, they also provided timely communication before, during, and after the job was completed.
His crew showed up promptly every day and even dealt with rain during the process.
The owner, Ralph, was very quick to respond with a very competitive quote.
One of them was Apex, spoke with Ralph the owner and he had his son Pearce call, and he came by the next day.
They are professional, prompt, personable, and have great communication skills!
With the holidays coming up I wasn't sure how quickly Apex would be able to come and inspect our roof.
Following the job completion, Ralph provided me with the warranties that come with all the GAF products that were applied to our roof, which I was not initially aware of but am very pleased with.
The 10 year workmanship warranty shows confidence in the work done.
All jobs are done very well and in a timely manner, backed by warranty; and if there is any issue, they respond and deal immediately!!
The new roof includes a full 10 year warranty on workmanship!
The next day I spoke with Ralph and he wanted to ensure I was happy with the work and he recapped their guarantee.
He gave me an outstanding quote (sans insurance estimate) that was competitive while providing top of the line materials.
Apex was the only roofer (from the three roofers contacted) who pointed out the wind damage on our old roof that our insurance company subsequently covered.
And he took care of obtaining the town and the HOA permits, and once he had those in hand, we set up the schedule to begin the job.
They take care of permits and daily clean-up.
The owner, Ralph, was extremely helpful explaining products and handling my MANY questions.
I met with both owners of the company, Ralph and Pierce Brehany.
Ralph and his son Pierce communicated with us very well and was easy to work with on this job.
The owner, Ralph, was very quick to respond with a very competitive quote.
Ralph responded immediately to our every concern.
Pierce was amazing!
I met with both owners of the company, Ralph and Pierce Brehany.
Ralph and his son Pierce communicated with us very well and was easy to work with on this job.
Ralph, Pierce, and their crews are amazing!!
Local Family Biz with Ralph and Son, Pierce, delivered best products and high level execution for our new roof installation.
I met with both owners of the company, Ralph and Pierce Brehany.
When neither Brehany was on site, one crew leader was assigned.
Ralph Brehany and Alex Mejia did an outstanding job.
From start to finish Ralph Brehany was a refreshing joy to work with.
Ralph Brehany is the exception to the rule!
Ralph Brehany and Alex Mejia did an outstanding job.
The crew, led by Alex, was terrific, and worked extremely hard to make it right.
THANK YOU Ralph, Pierce, Alex and the crew!

settled.text: Titles: homepage SEO title uses "Hilton Head Island Metropolitan Area"; homepage H1 uses a familiar name (Lowcountry / South Carolina Lowcountry); service titles `Service Name - Apex Roofing of the Lowcountry` (no area); brand always in full.
Not on the site until confirmed: "& Coastal Georgia", "homes and businesses", "residential and commercial inspections", ShingleMaster, "payment arrangements".

Paul 2026-10-12: 2a revised to option A — a who-issues-the-permit FAQ is added on Okatie (Beaufort or Jasper County, by address), Levy (Jasper County, roof replacement) and Pritchardville (Beaufort County or the Town of Bluffton, check the address), each answered from its own jurisdiction's source,

Paul 2026-10-09: no Old Town historic review or UDO roof-material claims (UDO 3.18 and Article 5 NEEDs dropped) unless evidence is found; none found in this run. The Old Town FAQ now only tells the homeowner to ask the Town before choosing a material.

Paul 2026-10-12: Roof replacement price on the page = the Lowcountry standard ranges (d-price-replacement-standard-2026): architectural asphalt $350-$475/sq (about $14,000-$20,000 on a typical 1,800-2,000 sq ft home); standing seam metal $700-$1,200/sq (about $24,000-$45,000+). Not the review. The r

Paul: Metal Roofing FAQ 'How much does a metal roof cost?' uses the most-confirmed regional ranges — standing seam about $16,600 to $32,000+ for a typical home; coastal Lowcountry about $30,000 to $45,000+; stated as published cost-guide ranges, not Apex's price; $24,000 removed from the Metal draft
